faq.title: Straight answers.
faq.q1: What is the difference between One-Step and Instant?
faq.a1: One-Step is an evaluation: you reach a 10% profit target within a 4% daily / 6% max drawdown. Instant skips the evaluation and funds the account immediately with 3% daily / 5% max drawdown.
faq.a2: On equity, which is balance plus unrealized PnL. Daily drawdown is measured from your daily starting balance (reset at 00:00 UTC); max drawdown is measured from the initial account size.
faq.q3: What happens if I breach a limit?
faq.a3: All open positions are closed at market, the account is marked failed and the breach reason is recorded. You can purchase a new account at any time.
faq.a4: You can request a payout every 14 days once KYC is verified and a wallet address is set. Your payout is 80% of realised profit, sent in USDT. The remaining 20% stays with SOGDIA.
faq.a5: The top 50 USDT pairs, long or short, with leverage from 1× to 200×, 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.
faq.a6: In crypto through NOWPayments. Your account is created automatically as soon as the payment is confirmed on-chain.
